summary.name: Zoom Workplace
summary.one_liner: Zoom's AI-first work platform bundling video meetings, team chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events.
use_cases: Handling customer calls in a contact center
Building video into apps with an SDK
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Zoom as an AI-first work platform combining video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events. It names a Zoom Video SDK for building custom video experiences into apps. Customer case studies describe use for contact center call handling with CRM integration, call reporting and visibility, simulation training, and high-quality broadcasts with streaming-studio output. The page itself gives no detailed feature specifications or pricing.
notable: Bundles meetings, chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center and events in one platform
Zoom Video SDK for custom in-app video
Contact center with CRM integration and per-call reporting (per customer case studies)
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing or plan limits
Platform support beyond the web is not clearly named on the page; iOS and Android are not explicitly mentioned in the page text
